description: Trading rules — three sections: TIERS + ENTRY RULES per asset class + RISK RULES universal
architecture: Section 0 = Trade TIERS (scalping vs swing). Section 1 = WHEN to enter (per asset). Section 2 = HOW MUCH to risk and WHEN to exit (all assets).

section_0_tiers.description: Two tiers of trades. Tier 1 is for future automation (Bitget scalper). Tier 2 is what Maria places manually now.

tier_1_scalping.label: TIER 1 — AUTOMATION ONLY — do not place manually
tier_1_scalping.purpose: Future automated execution via Bitget API (scalper-run.js or similar)
tier_1_scalping.stop_loss: Very tight — a few pips from entry
tier_1_scalping.execution: NOT manual. Will be automated once Bitget system is ready.

eligible_assets.stocks: High-liquidity only: NVDA, TSLA, AAPL, MSFT, META, GOOGL, AMZN

tier_1_scalping.briefing_format: Brief overview table only. No full trade cards.

tier_2_swing.label: TIER 2 — PLACE MANUALLY
tier_2_swing.purpose: Manual placement by Maria in TradingView paper trading
tier_2_swing.stop_loss: Medium — based on clear support/resistance levels
tier_2_swing.execution: Manual — Maria places limit orders with stop and target

eligible_assets.crypto: BTC, ETH, SOL, FET, RENDER, TAO on 4H-Daily charts

tier_2_swing.briefing_format: Full trade cards with Entry, Stop, Target, R:R, Units, Alerts, Why.

forex.character: Session-driven, macro/news sensitive, highest liquidity of any market

strategies.name: London Session Breakout
strategies.when_to_use: Price ranging overnight, London open creates directional break
strategies.entry_long: Price breaks ABOVE previous day high at London open (10:00-11:00 Oslo) with EMA 20 pointing up
strategies.entry_short: Price breaks BELOW previous day low at London open with EMA 20 pointing down
strategies.avoid: NFP, CPI, Fed decisions — no trade 30min either side

strategies.name: EMA 8/21 Crossover + RSI Filter
strategies.when_to_use: Trending markets. Best when macro direction is clear.
strategies.entry_long: EMA 8 crosses ABOVE EMA 21 AND RSI > 50 AND price above both EMAs
strategies.entry_short: EMA 8 crosses BELOW EMA 21 AND RSI < 50
strategies.stop_loss: Behind most recent swing high (shorts) or swing low (longs)
strategies.confluence_check: Align with macro trend — check ECB vs Fed policy direction

strategies.name: Pin Bar Reversal at Key Levels
strategies.when_to_use: Price reaches well-established support/resistance and shows rejection candle
strategies.entry_long: Pin bar (long lower wick) forms AT key support level
strategies.entry_short: Pin bar (long upper wick) forms AT key resistance level
strategies.stop_loss: Just beyond the tail of the pin bar
strategies.notes: Pure price action. High probability only when aligned with trend.

best_sessions_oslo.avoid: 30min before/after earnings releases and Fed decisions

strategies.name: EMA 50/200 Trend + RSI Pullback
strategies.when_to_use: Outside earnings season. Index in clear uptrend above EMA 200.
strategies.entry_long: Price above EMA 200 AND EMA 50 > EMA 200 AND RSI pulls back to 40-50 — enter on bounce
strategies.entry_short: Price below EMA 200 AND RSI bounces to 50-60 — enter on rejection
strategies.earnings_rule: EXIT all positions 2 days before earnings season begins

strategies.name: Triple Screen — Weekly Trend + Daily MACD
strategies.when_to_use: Align daily trade with weekly trend picture
strategies.entry_long: Weekly trend up (price > EMA 13 weekly) AND Daily MACD histogram turns positive
strategies.entry_short: Weekly trend down AND Daily MACD histogram turns negative
strategies.stop_loss: Below most recent daily swing low
strategies.take_profit: At resistance or when weekly trend weakens
strategies.notes: Never trade against the weekly trend. Elder first rule.

earnings_season_special.name: Post-Earnings Gap Trading
earnings_season_special.when_to_use: ONLY during earnings season (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct). Individual stocks only.
earnings_season_special.entry_rule: Wait for earnings release. Gap UP > 3% on high volume — enter LONG within first 30 minutes
earnings_season_special.risk_reduction: Use HALF normal position size — earnings are binary events
earnings_season_special.avoid: Never enter BEFORE earnings are released

commodities.character: Macro-driven by USD strength, inflation, geopolitics, OPEC

best_sessions_oslo.gold_silver: 10:00 Oslo (London) and 15:30 Oslo (NY) — two peak windows
best_sessions_oslo.oil: 15:30 Oslo (NY open). OPEC news typically 12:00-14:00 Oslo

strategies.name: Gold vs USD Inverse Correlation
strategies.when_to_use: When USD has clear directional trend from Fed policy
strategies.entry_long: DXY falling (USD weakening) AND Gold above EMA 50
strategies.entry_short: DXY rising (USD strengthening) AND Gold below EMA 50
strategies.macro_check: Always check DXY before trading Gold. They move opposite 80% of the time.

strategies.name: Bollinger Band Squeeze Breakout
strategies.when_to_use: After period of low volatility — bands visibly narrow on chart
strategies.entry_long: Bands squeeze then price breaks ABOVE upper band with above-average volume
strategies.entry_short: Bands squeeze then price breaks BELOW lower band with above-average volume
strategies.take_profit: 2x the Bollinger Band width at time of breakout

strategies.name: Oil EMA Trend + OPEC News Filter
strategies.source: Energy commodity traders and macro analysts
strategies.when_to_use: When OPEC stance is known and no meeting is imminent
strategies.entry_long: EMA 20 > EMA 50 AND no major OPEC supply increase expected within 2 weeks
strategies.entry_short: EMA 20 < EMA 50 OR OPEC announces production increase
strategies.override_rule: OPEC surprise announcement — EXIT immediately regardless of position

crypto.character: 24/7 market, high volatility, sentiment-driven, follows BTC dominance cycle

best_sessions_oslo.avoid: Weekend trading — low volume, wider spreads, erratic moves
best_sessions_oslo.note: Crypto never closes but signal quality is lower on weekends

crypto.btc_dominance_rule: Check BTC.D before altcoins. BTC dominance RISING = avoid altcoins. FALLING = altcoins outperform.

strategies.name: Golden Cross / Death Cross
strategies.source: Institutional traders — most followed BTC macro signal
strategies.when_to_use: Weekly chart only. Identifying major bull or bear cycles.
strategies.entry_long: EMA 50 crosses ABOVE EMA 200 — Golden Cross, major bull signal
strategies.entry_short: EMA 50 crosses BELOW EMA 200 — Death Cross, major bear signal
strategies.stop_loss: Below most recent weekly swing low
strategies.notes: Slow high-conviction signal. Do not use on daily — too many false signals.

strategies.name: EMA 21/55 + RSI Trend Filter
strategies.source: Raoul Pal, Michael van de Poppe
strategies.when_to_use: Daily chart. BTC in defined trend and RSI confirms momentum.
strategies.entry_long: EMA 21 crosses ABOVE EMA 55 AND RSI > 50
strategies.entry_short: EMA 21 crosses BELOW EMA 55 AND RSI < 50

strategies.name: MACD + Volume Breakout (Altcoins)
strategies.when_to_use: BTC dominance flat or falling AND altcoin shows MACD momentum with volume
strategies.entry_long: MACD line crosses ABOVE signal line AND volume > 20-period average
strategies.entry_short: MACD crosses BELOW signal line AND volume spike on red candle
strategies.stop_loss: Below breakout level or -5% from entry — whichever is closer
strategies.risk_note: Altcoins more volatile than BTC — use HALF normal position size

position_sizing.description: How much to risk on every trade — regardless of asset class
position_sizing.crypto_altcoin_max_risk: 0.5-1% only — higher volatility demands smaller size
position_sizing.max_portfolio_heat: 6% maximum across ALL open trades simultaneously
position_sizing.formula: Position size = (Account x Risk%) / Stop distance

placement_by_asset.crypto_btc: Below EMA 55 or most recent weekly swing low
placement_by_asset.crypto_altcoins: Below EMA 50 or -5% from entry — whichever is closer

stop_loss.trailing_stop_rule: Once trade reaches +1R profit — move stop to breakeven. Cannot lose on this trade.
stop_loss.order_expiry: Day only — cancel all unfilled orders end of trading session. No stale orders overnight.

take_profit.minimum_reward_to_risk: 2:1 — target at least 2x what you risk

preferred_by_asset.crypto_altcoins: 2:1 minimum — altcoins reverse fast, do not be greedy

methods.fibonacci: 1.618 extension of the prior swing move
methods.rsi_extreme: Exit when RSI hits 70+ on entry timeframe
methods.partial_exit: Take 50% profit at 1:1, move stop to breakeven, let rest run to full target

entry_filters.candle_confirmation: EMA crossover must be confirmed by CLOSE of candle — never enter mid-candle
entry_filters.higher_timeframe_alignment: Always check weekly trend before daily signal. Never trade against weekly tide.
entry_filters.news_blackout: No entries 30 minutes before or after major news releases

news_to_avoid: NFP — Non-Farm Payrolls (first Friday of month, 14:30 Oslo)
Fed Rate Decision (FOMC 8x per year, 20:00 Oslo)
ECB Rate Decision (14:15 Oslo on meeting days)
OPEC Meetings (oil only — can spike 3-5% instantly)

session_times_oslo.timezone: Norway — CET (UTC+1 winter) / CEST (UTC+2 summer April-October)
session_times_oslo.weekend_rule: Markets closed Sat-Sun (except crypto). First trade: Monday 10:00 Oslo.

trade_management.max_losses_before_pause: Stop after 3 consecutive losses. Review what went wrong.
trade_management.daily_loss_limit: Lose 3% of account in one day — stop for the day
trade_management.weekly_loss_limit: Lose 5% of account in one week — stop for the week
trade_management.no_revenge_trading: A loss is a cost of doing business. Never double size to recover.
trade_management.no_fomo: Missing a trade is better than forcing a bad entry. Another setup comes tomorrow.
trade_management.journal: Record every trade: asset, entry, stop, target, result, reason. Review weekly.
trade_management.scaling: Do not increase position size until 10+ consecutive profitable trades.

psychology_rules.think_in_R: 1R = your risk. 2R win = made 2x your risk. Think in R not dollars.
psychology_rules.discipline: Strategy is only as good as execution. Follow the rules exactly.
psychology_rules.patience: Most days there is NO good setup. Waiting is a valid action.
psychology_rules.detachment: Your self-worth is not your P&L. A losing trade does not make you a bad trader.

risk_reward_ratio.description: Only enter a trade if potential profit is at least 2x the potential loss
risk_reward_ratio.example: If your stop loss is $2.50 away from entry, your take profit must be at least $5.00 away
risk_reward_ratio.when_to_check: BEFORE entering any trade — if the ratio is less than 1:2, do NOT enter

stop_loss_direction_rule.description: The stop loss may ONLY ever move TOWARD profit — never further away from entry
stop_loss_direction_rule.rule: Never move SL further from entry to avoid being stopped out — that is emotional trading and is forbidden
stop_loss_direction_rule.break_even_trigger: Once price moves 50% toward take profit, move SL up to at least break-even (entry price)
stop_loss_direction_rule.example_long: You buy at $100 with TP at $110. When price reaches $105 (50% toward TP), move SL to $100 (entry price)
stop_loss_direction_rule.violation: Moving SL DOWN on a long trade is forbidden — no exceptions

stop_loss_placement_support.description: Place SL below real support levels, not at round numbers
stop_loss_placement_support.step_1: Find a real support level on the chart — a price where the asset has bounced before
stop_loss_placement_support.step_2: Place SL just below that support level
stop_loss_placement_support.step_3: Add a buffer of $0.20–$0.50 below the support level to avoid normal price noise triggering the stop
stop_loss_placement_support.avoid: Do NOT place SL at round numbers like $80 or $85
stop_loss_placement_support.reason: Round numbers attract stop hunters who push price down to trigger stops before reversing

trailing_stop_loss.description: Automatically lock in profit as price rises without watching the screen constantly
trailing_stop_loss.activation: Once price has moved 50% of the way toward take profit, activate a trailing stop
trailing_stop_loss.direction_rule: Trailing stop only moves UPWARD for long trades — never back down
trailing_stop_loss.purpose: Locks in profit automatically while letting winners run further

short_trade_rules.description: Mirror of LONG rules for SHORT (sell) trades — same logic reversed

when_to_short.trend: Price is in a clear downtrend — lower highs and lower lows on Daily chart
when_to_short.entry_level: Price has bounced up to a resistance level and is starting to fall
when_to_short.entry: Sell at resistance level where price is starting to drop

short_trade_parameters.stop_loss: Above entry — if price rises above resistance, exit
short_trade_parameters.take_profit: Below entry at next support level

short_vs_long_differences.order_type: Sell Limit instead of Buy Limit
short_vs_long_differences.stop_loss_direction: ABOVE entry (price going up = losing on short)
short_vs_long_differences.take_profit_direction: BELOW entry (price going down = winning on short)
short_vs_long_differences.alerts: Entry = Crossing Down, Stop Loss = Crossing Up, Take Profit = Crossing Down

time_based_exit.description: Close trades that are going nowhere — do not let money sit in flat positions
time_based_exit.time_limit: 48 hours with no meaningful movement toward take profit
time_based_exit.meaningful_movement: Price must have moved at least 30% toward take profit within 48 hours
time_based_exit.action: If not — consider closing the trade
time_based_exit.reason: Money stuck in a flat trade is wasted capital that could be used elsewhere
time_based_exit.applies_especially_to: Crypto trades — these are expected to move quickly

scanning_priority_matrix.description: How I decide WHICH assets to scan in morning briefing
scanning_priority_matrix.step_1: Always scan session fixed assets (8 core assets)
scanning_priority_matrix.step_2: Search morning news for AI/tech/geo events
scanning_priority_matrix.step_3: Any news mentioning a layer_1 to layer_7 asset with >2% move — add to scan
scanning_priority_matrix.step_4: If earnings season (Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct) — check layer_2 hyperscalers for gaps
scanning_priority_matrix.step_5: Never scan more than 20 assets total per day — quality over quantity
scanning_priority_matrix.step_6: Pick 1 best trade per session (max 3 trades per day)
